as_told.title: Parsons recites the Hymn to Pan at rocket tests

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that Jack Parsons, whom he calls the godfather of American rocketry and founder of the Jet Propulsion Laboratory, a rocket research lab in California, would often recite the occultist Aleister Crowley's version of a hymn to the Greek god Pan before every rocket test. Michels tells it to show that ritual and magic sat right at the heart of early American rocket science.
